summary: Zahi Hawass: workers' cemetery at Giza shows the pyramids were built by Egyptian craftsmen, not slaves; workers buried beside their king.
content: Zahi Hawass: discoveries at the tombs of the pyramid builders at Giza demonstrate the pyramids were built by Egyptian craftsmen and not slaves. If they had been slaves, they would not have been granted the honor of being buried beside their king. Tombs dated to 4th Dynasty. One tomb belonged to an overseer named Idu. Graffiti in the relieving chambers includes 'Year 17 of Khufu' and the name of a worker gang, the 'Friends of Khufu'.
